diff.text: A curated collection of resources and projects focused on Omarchy.

Contributions are welcome! Please see our [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/aorumbayev/awesome-omarchy/blob/17fd82729be95b502359dac0399f7e6e965fe6c6/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details on how to submit themes, tools, or other resources.

changed.before: A curated list of awesome Omarchy themes, resources, and tools for the modern Arch Linux/Hyprland setup.
changed.after: Find official Omarchy resources, alternative implementations, themes, development tools, related configurations, community discussions, and installation experiences.

changed.before: [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org/) is an opinionated Arch Linux/Hyprland configuration that transforms a fresh Arch installation into a fully-configured, beautiful, and modern desktop environment with a single command.
changed.after: The source describes [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org/) as an opinionated Arch Linux/Hyprland configuration that transforms a fresh Arch installation into a fully configured, beautiful, modern desktop environment with a single command.

changed.before: - [hyprwhspr](https://github.com/goodroot/hyprwhspr) - Native speech-to-text for Arch / Omarchy - Fast, accurate and easy system-wide Whisper dictation.
changed.after: - [hyprwhspr](https://github.com/goodroot/hyprwhspr) - Native speech-to-text for Arch / Omarchy - System-wide Whisper dictation.

changed.before: - [omarchy-hub](https://github.com/deepakness/omarchy-hub) - A comprehensive resource library for Omarchy Linux.
changed.after: - [omarchy-hub](https://github.com/deepakness/omarchy-hub) - A resource library for Omarchy Linux.
- [omarchy-motivator-theme](https://github.com/rondilley/omarchy-motivator-theme) - Omarchy theme intended to increase motivation.

changed.before: - [omarchy-fire-and-shadow-theme](https://github.com/mattbbia/fire-and-shadow) - A moody, somber theme base on the paintings of Joseph Wright.
changed.after: - [omarchy-fire-and-shadow-theme](https://github.com/mattbbia/fire-and-shadow) - A moody, somber theme based on the paintings of Joseph Wright.

changed.before: - [omarchy-migrate](https://github.com/CyphrRiot/Migrate) - Stunningly beautiful terminal backup and restore tool written in Pure Go.
changed.after: - [omarchy-migrate](https://github.com/CyphrRiot/Migrate) - Terminal backup and restore tool written in Pure Go.

changed.before: - [omarchy-cleaner](https://github.com/maxart/omarchy-cleaner) - Quickly and easily remove pre-installed apps and webapps.
- [edit](https://github.com/mirarr-app/editt) - Beautiful image viewer and editor with Omarchy styling support.
changed.after: - [edit](https://github.com/mirarr-app/editt) - Image viewer and editor with Omarchy styling support.

changed.before: - [live-wallpaper-for-omarchy-linux](https://github.com/daurydicaprio/live-wallpaper-for-omarchy-linux) - A robust script to manage and cycle through live video wallpapers on Omarchy/Hyprland.
changed.after: - [live-wallpaper-for-omarchy-linux](https://github.com/daurydicaprio/live-wallpaper-for-omarchy-linux) - A script to manage and cycle through live video wallpapers on Omarchy/Hyprland.
